source.note: 1977 Topps flagship baseball set. Checklist is 660 cards distributed in one series. True RC status is applied only to cards identified on TCDB's Rookie Cards index; the word Rookie or an All-Star Rookie designation alone does not trigger the RC suffix.

decisions.baseAvailability: All 660 flagship cards share the normal base pool; no base short prints are modeled.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Append RC to the player/name field only for recognized true rookie cards. Generic Rookie subset wording and All-Star Rookie designations do not qualify on their own.
decisions.relatedSetHandling: Mail-in Team Checklists, proofs, cloth stickers, O-Pee-Chee and other related issues are not included in the 660-card flagship Product.
decisions.subsetHandling: League Leaders, Record Breakers, LCS, World Series, Turn Back the Clock, Rookie Prospects, Big League Brothers, team cards, checklists and other base-set subsets remain part of the single Base ProductSet.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Flagship base set #1-660, distributed in one series. True RC cards have RC appended to the player/name field.
